definitions.gloss: running away from home, leaving home (without permission)
definitions.explanation: Leaving one's home abruptly, especially as a young person fleeing family conflict or unhappiness. Can also apply to adults who abandon their household.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：10973_chuugakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき{家出|いえで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I ran away from home once when I was in middle school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{家出|いえで}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: I ran away from home after fighting with my parents, but I came back after three days.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly associated with teenagers or young people running away from home due to family problems. {家出|いえで}⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧/⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧ (runaway boy/girl) is a set phrase. The word carries a sense of impulsive departure rather than a planned move. It differs from simply moving out (⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める) in that {家出|いえで} implies leaving without approval or in conflict.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家出|いえで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run away from home
- {家出|いえで}⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧: runaway boy
- {家出|いえで}⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧: runaway girl
- {家出|いえで}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: runaway, person who ran away from home
